|lore=Former warrant officer from Concord Dawn. Promoted due to superb performance. Specializes in transporting high-profile criminals. Twin brother of a famous mercenary.
|anagram=[[Tom Lischke]] was a Decipher game designer and the lead game designer of the Jedi Knights TCG.<ref name="jkrules">[https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115id_/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive], 20 August 2001.</ref> ''Sheckil'' rearranges Lischke.<ref name="geo">[https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413id_/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians] at oocities.org (GeoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref>
|joke=The "twin brother of a famous mercenary" line refers to Boba Fett; [[Jeremy Bulloch]] played both Sheckil and Boba Fett.<ref name="forum8378">[https://web.archive.org/web/20221210023930id_/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?f=87&t=8378 Easter Eggs], Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums (27 December 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20221210023930/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?f=87&t=8378 Internet Archive], 10 December 2022.</ref><ref name="wp-sheckil" /> See [[Jokes#Lieutenant Sheckil|Jokes]].
|game_text=During your control phase, may use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck, take one Human Shield into hand and reshuffle. When escorting a captive, captive is forfeit +2 and Sheckil is immune to attrition &lt; 4.
